critical_code_review_comments: Auth token key mismatch across the codebase: /api/auth/login returns 'token' (see server.py auth_router) but the ERP audit engine and multiple docs refer to 'access_token'; my test helper handles both. Standardize on one to avoid future client drift.

InsuranceIn requires customerName but /insurance form auto-fill from a delivered lead in Insurance.js only assigns it when a lead is chosen — creating a 'Manual (no lead)' entry without typing customerName returns 422. Consider defaulting customerName='' at server or making required=false to align UX.

POST /leads/{id}/extra-income requires canScheme (Active). If a lead is later Archived/Closed, extra-income lines can no longer be corrected. Consider allowing owner-role override for closed-lead corrections (or a canFinanceReceipt-style flag).
No DELETE /payments endpoint — U1 revert still requires Mongo access. Existing gap called out in iter11; still open.

audit_log rapidly grows (append-only) — no TTL / archival. Add an index or archive job before scale; also expose date-range filter (?from=&to=) alongside ?module= and ?leadId= for the /audit-log viewer.
recompute_lead is invoked by many mutations but not directly triggerable — a debug POST /admin/recompute-lead/{id} (owner-only) would simplify cleanup flows and support tickets.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13-14 fully verified. Key endpoint behaviours to reuse: (i) /api/auth/login returns {"token":"..."} (NOT 'access_token'); helper _login() in test_iter13_14_parity.py accepts both. (ii) /reports/production-audit returns {score, verdict, severityCounts, scoreBreakdown[list], categories[list of 16], blockers[list], goLive}; current score=95.3%, verdict='NOT READY FOR PRODUCTION' by design (GO LIVE requires ≥99%). (iii) /audit-log is owner-only, supports ?module= and ?leadId= filters, entries are append-only — do NOT delete. (iv) POST /insurance requires customerName; payoutRate normalizes any value >1 by /100 (so UI can safely send percent). (v) LD26000002/003/005 = Booked/Active/totalReceived=5000; LD26000006 = New (used for U1 end-to-end); after any mutation revert via Mongo (payments/bookings/claims/insurance/finance) then trigger recompute via a no-op PUT /extra-income.
rca of the issue: N/A — all iteration 13-14 acceptance criteria met with the following minor deltas: (a) InsuranceIn.customerName is a required Pydantic field so tests must include it; (b) production-audit's overall score is exposed as 'score' (float, e.g. 95.3), not nested under scoreBreakdown (scoreBreakdown is a per-category list); (c) auth returns 'token' key. Documented these in critical_code_review_comments to prevent client drift.
